failure_mode_detail: Regenerative chatter — process outside stability lobe
phone_call_notes: Inbound from Kevin Tanaka at Pacific Rim Precision. M01 exhibiting strong vibration during Boring Operation — alarm SPN-MJ-004. Vibration visible on parts and audible in shop. Machine did not auto-stop but part is clearly scrap. Customer suspects fixture loosening. Asked us to confirm if vibration profile matches bearing issue or chatter. X-axis RMS reading 6.69 mm/s at time of alarm.
investigation_notes: Field engineer Torres, R. (FE-09) attended site. Found toolholder taper dirty — significant fretting corrosion on HSK taper mating surface reducing contact stiffness. Fixture clamping hydraulic pressure measured at 7 bar (nominal 70 bar) — leak in fixture circuit reducing clamping force. Two independent causes both contributing to chatter. Taper cleaned and re-ground; hydraulic circuit repaired. Machine re-tested: chatter eliminated at standard parameters. Machine in good condition.
remedy_notes: Toolholder taper cleaned and re-lapped. Hydraulic fixture circuit repaired: replaced solenoid valve seal kit (PN: EIQ-HYD-SEAL-KIT). Pressure restored to 71 bar. Re-test: 20 consecutive parts — all within surface finish spec. Recommended annual toolholder taper inspection. Labour: 6.0 h under SILVER service contract (customer co-pay 20%).

failure_mode_detail: Progressive cutting edge wear beyond service life
phone_call_notes: Customer Appalachian Machine Works called — M01 threw hard alarm SPN-MJ-003 mid-program during Face Milling. Spindle load P002 peaked at 3.26% before drive tripped. Tool T17 found broken in spindle bore — approx 40mm of flute snapped. Last good part passed inspection; current part scrapped. Customer asking about warranty on tooling and whether machine caused the breakage or vice versa.
investigation_notes: Remote diagnostic session conducted with Petrov, A.. Reviewed P002 spindle load trend via OPC-UA historian — clear monotonic increase over prior 50 cycles consistent with progressive flank wear. NDCG feature trend confirms tool_wear classification. Kurtosis P064 = 5.3 (normal range 2.5–5.0). Recommended immediate tool replacement. Advised customer to calibrate tool life counter to actual tool life rather than theoretical. No machine fault — tooling and process issue. Error code SPN-MJ-003 confirmed appropriate.
remedy_notes: Tool T17 replaced with new insert grade IC900 (customer's standard). Tool life counter reset to 0. Coolant concentration checked and adjusted to 9% (from 4.9%). First-off part inspected: dimensions within tolerance, surface finish Ra 0.8 μm achieved. Production resumed. Customer advised to increase tool change frequency by 20% for this material/operation combination and to check coolant concentration weekly. No chargeable service.

failure_mode_detail: Mechanical or electrical actuator failure
phone_call_notes: URGENT — Rio Grande Manufacturing reporting M01 stuck in tool change. ATC arm stopped mid-swing, alarm LUB-CR-001 active. Machine cannot be reset — arm is blocking spindle access. Production line stopped. Customer has 14 people waiting. Contact: Carlos Mendez, phone: (505) 555-0723. Machine S/N EIQ-M01-2020-4273. Requesting immediate escalation to field support.
investigation_notes: Field engineer Brennan, K. (FE-15) attended. Axis following error P016 = 7.690 mm on X-axis. Ball screw backlash measured: 0.010 mm (limit 0.005 mm — exceeded). Guide rail lubrication found dry on two carriages — lube distributor piston stuck in one SSV block. Root causes: (1) lube blockage causing guide friction increase; (2) ball screw nut preload loss. Both corrected: SSV block replaced, lube cycle verified, servo backlash compensation adjusted.
remedy_notes: SSV lube distributor block replaced (PN: EIQ-LUB-SSV-6). Ball screw backlash compensation parameter adjusted from 0.003 to 0.006 mm. Lubrication system primed and verified — all 18 lube points confirmed receiving oil. Following error P016 re-tested: max 0.008 mm on rapid traverse — within specification. Machine re-qualified. Parts cost: $201. Labour: 4.8 h.
rma_description: Servo drive returned under warranty claim — internal IGBT failure
rma_disposition: Drive tested at factory — confirmed IGBT module failure. Within 24-month warranty period. Full replacement issued at no charge.

investigation_notes: Technical investigation by Williams, S.. Downloaded vibration data from Bosch CISS sensor for run_id M01_Feb_2020_SYN_079.
